title: Relative Atomic Mass
content: Relative atomic mass is the average mass of one atom of that element compared to one twelfth the mass of one atom of carbon-12.
e: Relative atomic mass is the average mass of one atom of that element compared to one twelfth the mass of one atom of carbon-12. Relative atomic mass compares the average atom of an element with one-twelfth of carbon-12.

title: Empirical Formula
content: Empirical formula shows the simplest whole number ratio of atoms in a compound.
e: Empirical formula shows the simplest whole number ratio of atoms in a compound. An empirical formula is the simplest whole-number ratio of atoms in a compound.

title: Molecular Formula
content: Molecular formula shows the total number of atoms of each element present in one molecule or one formula unit of the compound.
e: Molecular formula shows the total number of atoms of each element present in one molecule or one formula unit of the compound. A molecular formula shows the actual number of each atom in a molecule.

title: Oxidation Number
content: Oxidation number describes the combining capacity of the element and also indicates the positive and negative nature of its atoms in the compounds.
e: Oxidation number describes the combining capacity of the element and also indicates the positive and negative nature of its atoms in the compounds. Oxidation number is a bookkeeping charge that tracks electron transfer. Here they want Oxidation Number.

title: Law of Conservation of Mass
content: Law of Conservation of Mass states that the total mass of the reactant(s) is equal to the total mass of the product(s).
e: Law of Conservation of Mass states that the total mass of the reactant(s) is equal to the total mass of the product(s). In a closed system, the total mass of reactants equals the total mass of products.
